title: Lean Six Sigma flashcards: statistics, DMAIC and lean tools at Black Belt level
description: Lean Six Sigma Black Belt: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
sourceShort: the NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods and Wikipedia
notice: This deck is independent. It is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by ASQ or any other body that certifies Lean Six Sigma or Six Sigma practitioners. It does not use any certifying body's body of knowledge, exam content or study materials, and it makes no claim to match any exam. Cards are drafted with AI assistance only from the public sources cited on each card: chiefly the NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods (a US Government work), English Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0) and US EPA and NIST lean guidance. Every card is checked against its source and reviewed by a person.

changelog.notes: Released, after an independent audit of every card against its source.

checks.what: An independent audit read all 600 cards against the NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook, the cached Wikipedia articles and the tier C lean sources, and checked every scenario's explanation letters against its choices
checks.result: 1 wrong answer, 4 ambiguous, 10 unsupported and 13 unclear cards were fixed; the Ppk card was removed because its only source is disputed, and cards resting on "citation needed" text were re-sourced.
